## How it was tested
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] tests added or updated; none weakened or skipped
- [ ] `npm run docs:check` (if documentation changed)
- [ ] `npm run contract:check` (if the API changed; generated files regenerated)
- [ ] no secrets, keys, personal data or large data files
